# Ecommerce AI video skills for Claude Code and AI agents

> Turn a product photo into the video ad formats that sell on TikTok Shop, Reels and Meta in 2026: ASMR unboxing, problem → solution, singing mascot jingle, try-on, dropshipping guide reel, 20 hook variants, localized versions and a compliance check. Open agent skills (vargHQ/skills) tested end to end on varg.ai, from $0.05 to $9 per run.

## For agents
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/vargHQ/ecommerce-ai-video-skills/blob/main/AGENTS.md): what to ask the seller, how to pick a format, checks before posting
- [working-themes.json](https://github.com/vargHQ/ecommerce-ai-video-skills/blob/main/working-themes.json): 10 formats with evidence, skill, cost and example video
- [PROMPTS.md](https://github.com/vargHQ/ecommerce-ai-video-skills/blob/main/PROMPTS.md): the tested prompts behind every example

## Skills
- [Turn product photos into an AI ASMR unboxing video](https://varg.ai/how-to/skills/ai-unboxing-video) ([code](https://github.com/vargHQ/skills/tree/main/varg-unboxing-video)): product photos → hands-only ASMR unboxing
- [Turn product photos into AI video that keeps the logo and shape](https://varg.ai/how-to/skills/consistent-product-ai-video) ([code](https://github.com/vargHQ/skills/tree/main/varg-product-lock)): keep the product identical in every AI shot
- [Turn an AI video ad into a TikTok Shop and Meta compliance report](https://varg.ai/how-to/skills/tiktok-shop-ad-compliance-check) ([code](https://github.com/vargHQ/skills/tree/main/ai-ad-compliance-check)): AI ad → TikTok Shop / Meta / FTC / EU compliance report
- [Turn winning competitor ads into new AI video ad angles](https://varg.ai/how-to/skills/competitor-ad-remix) ([code](https://github.com/vargHQ/skills/tree/main/varg-ad-library-remix)): winning competitor ads → new angles
- [Turn one winning video ad into 20 AI ad variations](https://varg.ai/how-to/skills/ai-ad-variations) ([code](https://github.com/vargHQ/skills/tree/main/varg-ad-variants)): one winning ad → 20 variants
- [Turn a product into an AI singing mascot jingle ad](https://varg.ai/how-to/skills/singing-mascot-jingle-ad) ([code](https://github.com/vargHQ/skills/tree/main/varg-mascot-jingle-ad)): product → singing mascot ad
- [Turn one video ad into 8 languages with AI dubbing](https://varg.ai/how-to/skills/ai-video-ad-translation) ([code](https://github.com/vargHQ/skills/tree/main/varg-ad-localize)): one ad → 8+ markets
- [Turn a flat-lay photo into an AI virtual try-on video](https://varg.ai/how-to/skills/ai-virtual-try-on-video) ([code](https://github.com/vargHQ/skills/tree/main/varg-tryon-video)): flat-lay → try-on video
- [Turn product photos into a viral product hook](https://varg.ai/how-to/skills/varg-product-hook) ([code](https://github.com/vargHQ/skills/tree/main/varg-product-hook)): product photos → viral product hook
- [Turn a product into a dropshipping guide reel](https://varg.ai/how-to/skills/varg-dropship-reel) ([code](https://github.com/vargHQ/skills/tree/main/varg-dropship-reel)): product → 60 s dropshipping guide reel
